title: Reading: Nelly the Nurse
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet, Reading Part 3 text 2 (with model answers)

scenes.t: This is Nelly. She's a nurse. She's tall and thin. She works at the hospital. She looks after sick people.
She gets up at six o'clock in the morning. She takes a shower and puts on her clothes.
Then she eats breakfast at half past six. At seven o'clock, she drives her car to the hospital.
Nelly starts work at eight o'clock. She cleans the rooms in the hospital. Then, she helps the doctors.
At twelve o'clock, she has lunch. She goes home at five o'clock.
At home, she takes a shower and she cooks dinner. She has dinner at half past six in the evening. Then, she watches TV.
At ten o'clock, she goes to bed.

o: No, she is tall and thin

items.q: What time does she get up?
What time does she have breakfast?
Does she cook dinner at the hospital?
What time does she have dinner?
o: At half past six in the evening

items.q: What time does she go to bed?
